name: muon3-hw
description: Muon3 station board: circuit, placement, topological routing and Gerber output, all in TypeScript.

scripts.drc: cd out/kicad && kicad-cli pcb drc --refill-zones --severity-error --severity-warning -o drc.json muon3.kicad_pcb
scripts.bench:drc: cd out/bench/kicad && kicad-cli pcb drc --refill-zones --severity-error --severity-warning -o drc.json muon3.kicad_pcb
scripts.bench:sim: python3 sim/bench_traces.py && python3 sim/bench_afe.py && python3 sim/bench_thermal.py
